snippet.title: Templar Assault - Beginner Tips - Battle Tactics
snippet.description:
Learn the basic battle tactics of the turn-based strategy war game for Android, Templar Assault.  This beginner tips section covers defensive CP, how to keep your squad together, and phalanx fire.

On the Google Play market - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tresebrothers.games.templars&feature=more_from_developer
